about: Drishti Elements: reusable JavaScript libraries. Each library: ES modules under src/ and one bundled file written by tools/elements/build.py. css and scripts (a vendored engine) paths are relative to the root of the release tree; module: the host's own grouping of libraries (a host may allow only some modules); assets: folders under that root a library reads at run time (map shapes, the code editor's engine), shipped with it by the distribution (tools/elements/dist.py).

drishti-core.title: Formats, theme, API client, events, accessibility, resize, keys, dialogs, drawers and toasts, the filter model every library shares, the element maker and placements, Explain's drawing, chips for list attributes, the CSV writer, reading typed numbers, loading vendored engines
drishti-core.summary: Formats, theme tokens, the API client, events, accessibility, dialogs, toasts, the state kit, the command palette and the loader

drishti-inputs.title: Inputs: business-date and range pickers with holiday calendars, the on/off switch, the tree picker, the multi-select, the combobox with server type-ahead (on its own field or a page's), forms from a schema (live or embedded, steps, named fields, hooks, custom widgets, time, date-and-time and money) with four eyes, the time and date-and-time pickers, the filter bar, the code editor over CodeMirror, a resizable split pane, tabs, a searchable grouped list and tree, a column-mapping table, and a page's own date fields and checkbox lists upgraded in place
drishti-inputs.summary: Date and range pickers, multi-select, combobox, forms from a schema, the filter bar, the code editor

drishti-grid.title: The grid: its engine (columns, row models, virtual scrolling, pivot, selection, export, keyboard) and its look (Grid and <drishti-grid> in three layouts and three densities), cell editing with undo, paste, write-back and four eyes, and the AG Grid-style adapter (createGridFromAgOptions)
drishti-grid.summary: The grid and its pivot: virtual rows, tree data, ranges, editing, live sets, export, an AG Grid-style adapter

drishti-tree.title: The tree: hierarchies as an org chart, an indented tree with measures (on drishti-grid's tree data), a sunburst and an icicle; expand and collapse, search with breadcrumbs, measures on nodes with non-additive ones (◆) asked of the server and never summed, Explain, re-parenting in an edit mode that proposes the move for four eyes, the outline of an authoring screen (marks, a hiding filter, a designer's selection followed both ways, moves by drag or Alt+arrows), export, keyboard and ARIA
drishti-tree.summary: Hierarchies as a tree grid, an org chart, a sunburst or an icicle, with measures and an edit mode

drishti-designer.title: The designer kit: the layout canvas over a layout model (grid or flow: place, move, resize with snap, multi-select, align, distribute, z-order, groups, copy and paste, a phone's order, the keys, undo and redo on one command stack), the palette, the inspector (a form from a schema), the outline (drishti-tree's, drag to re-order or re-parent), the YAML pane kept in step with the model both ways (completion and lint from a JSON Schema) and the designer shell (three panes, Visual / YAML / Both, versions, Validate, Preview, History, Impact, Propose for review)
drishti-designer.summary: The designer kit: layout canvas, palette, inspector, outline, YAML pane, undo and redo, the designer shell

drishti-data.title: Data: one data-source contract (in memory, REST pages, server-side rows, Arrow, live: any feed, a drishti-events subscription among them), backpressure into a grid, and the Arrow client
drishti-data.summary: One data-source contract (memory, REST, server-side rows, Arrow, live) and the Arrow client

drishti-chart.title: The chart: one engine-neutral spec over the vendored ECharts (the general kinds, the maps from world to every country's first-level regions, the card and studio modes, the map's ranking and table modes), Explain on any mark, the data table, export, linked selection and live updates; Vega-Lite translated into the spec
drishti-chart.summary: One chart spec over ECharts: the general kinds, maps from the world to first-level regions, Explain, export

drishti-graph.title: The graph: networks cyclic or acyclic on a canvas for thousands of nodes; force (seeded), layered (DAG), radial, circular and grouped layouts; zoom, pan, minimap and fit; neighbours expanded on demand; the shortest path; groups collapsed by an attribute and filters by type; size and colour by a measure with a legend; pin, multi-select and lasso; a selection panel with Explain; linked selection; export (PNG, SVG, data); keyboard and an adjacency table; live updates; the lineage preset; the view's graph panel
drishti-graph.summary: Networks on a canvas for thousands of nodes: layouts, paths, groups, selection, an adjacency table

drishti-events.title: Events in the page, across tabs and with a server: topics with wildcards, publish and subscribe, request and reply, streams as async iterators, typed topics and checked kinds, routes between the page, the tabs and a server, the library's own events as $events topics, and one clock for every timer (a test clock in tests)
drishti-events.summary: Events in the page, across tabs and with a server: topics, publish and subscribe, request and reply, streams

drishti-views.title: Views: whole screens from a ViewModel. The open specification (contract 1.x: a pinned copy of drishti-rachana's spec/1/viewmodel.schema.json) and its validator (normal and strict, the bounds, the refused keys); the painter (paint and its handle): the title line, the strip, the freshness line and the function keys, the panels' frames and their states, the layout (two columns, named areas, tabs, folds, sections, a sticky area, the divider, the container's narrow and medium forms in the phone order); every kind of contract 1 (words, tables, pivots, tabs, charts and maps, the chart engine loaded only when a view has a chart); the frames of the live stream applied by identity in one animation frame, conflated, and a live stream over drishti-events; the <elements-view> element; the fluent builders of views and frames; the registry of panel kinds
drishti-views.summary: Whole screens from a ViewModel: the specification and its validator, the painter and every kind, live frames, <elements-view>, the builders
